description: Archive outdated Brain knowledge (archived=true) so generation stops using it, or restore it (archived=false). Archiving unpins the entry; nothing is deleted and it can be restored. Requires workspace settings permission. Agency entries need the agency owner or staff with Agency Brain permission and return memory_id null (use entry.id); entries synced from their source return 409 BRAIN_ENTRY_DERIVED. Intended for knowledge the user asked to retire. Reuse idempotency_key on retries.

archived.description: true archives the entry; false restores it.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_archive_brain_entry
title: Archive Brain Entry
